_capture.method: fetched with the Arena fetch tool (the development sandbox has no outbound network; CI does)
_capture.completeness: Complete response body as returned by the fetch tool: 2 open KXNHLSPREAD contracts plus the paging cursor, both on the same event (Utah at Vegas, 2026-09-24 preseason). Transcribed into this file at capture time; no value was edited.
_capture.why_it_matters: Proves the puck-line market is live and quotable right now (yes_bid/yes_ask/yes_ask_size_fp present), that the line lives in floor_strike + strike_type ('greater' = wins by MORE THAN k.5 goals), and -- critically -- that the numeric suffix of the ticker is NOT the strike: here VGK3 carries floor_strike 2.5 and VGK2 carries 1.5, while in the historical tier of the same series VGK2 carries 2.5 and VGK1 carries 1.5. Any parser that read the line out of the suffix would trade the wrong rung.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire after a winner is declared.
markets.rules_primary: If Vegas wins by over 2.5 goals in the Utah vs Vegas NHL game originally scheduled for Sep 24, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: If the game is postponed but begins within 48 hours of its originally scheduled start time, the market will remain open and resolve based on the official final result. If the game is cancelled or not started within 48 hours of its originally scheduled start, all markets will resolve to a fair price.
markets.title: Vegas wins by over 2.5 goals
